summary: Premium editorial edit: magazine hook on the three secrets, countdown on 'Tatlo dalawa isa', a slow push on 'disiplina', black and white on 'Dati wala akong follower', the search bar typing, the checklist ticking, the numbers landing, and the follow card at the end.
notes: The magazine cover opens on the hook 'tatlong sikreto ng viral na video'.
Black and white from 'Dati' until 'Ngayon' (the before / after turn).
The checklist ticks 'Mag-post', 'sagutin ang comments', 'i-check ang analytics' as they are said.
The number cards land on 'zero', 'isang libong followers' and 'tatlumpung araw'.
The profile card closes on 'I-follow mo ako'.
